terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro_read: These are the rules for using Vibe Live.
terms.intro_provider: You signed in with {{provider}}. Please review and accept before you continue.
terms.intro: Please review and accept before you continue.

s1.title: 1. Who can use Vibe Live
s1.body: You must be at least 18 years old and provide accurate information about yourself. One person, one account — accounts may not be shared, sold or transferred.

s2.title: 2. How you must behave
s2.body: Be respectful on every call and on your profile. Harassment, bullying, hate speech, threats, nudity or sexual content, impersonating someone else, spam and any illegal activity are not allowed.

s3.title: 3. Your content
s3.body: You are responsible for the photos, audio intro, tagline and description you upload, and you confirm you have the right to use them. We may remove content that breaks these rules.

s4.title: 4. Reporting and enforcement
s4.body: You can report anyone who breaks these rules from their profile. Reports are reviewed and accounts that violate these terms can be suspended or permanently removed without refund of unused promotional credit.

s5.title: 5. Calls, wallet and payments
s5.body: Calls are charged per minute at the rate shown on the host profile before the call starts, and deducted from your wallet balance. Recharges are processed by our payment partner; taxes may apply.

s6.title: 6. Privacy
s6.body: We collect only what the app needs to work — your profile details, wallet transactions and call records. Camera and microphone access are used for live calls only. See the Privacy Policy for the full detail.

s7.title: 7. Ending your account
s7.body: You can delete your account at any time from Profile → Account Privacy. We may suspend or end accounts that break these terms or the law.
